name: Attack Shark X1 Tri-Mode Wireless Gaming Mouse PAW3395PRO White
shortDescription: Attack Shark X1 Tri-Mode Wireless Gaming Mouse PAW3395PRO White with Touchpad RGB Charging Dock (Ultra-Lightweight 53g / Flagship PixArt PAW3395PRO Sensor Up to 40000 DPI / 700 IPS & 60G Acceleration / Omron 100M Cli
descriptionHtml:
Attack Shark X1 Tri-Mode Wireless Gaming Mouse PAW3395PRO White with Touchpad RGB Charging Dock (Ultra-Lightweight 53g / Flagship PixArt PAW3395PRO Sensor Up to 40000 DPI / 700 IPS & 60G Acceleration / Omron 100M Clicks Switches / Touchpad Magnetic RGB Dock / Included Anti-Slip Grip Tape / Tri-Mode 2.4GHz, Bluetooth & USB-C / Official 1-Year Local Warranty)

Elevate your desktop setup aesthetics and dominate esports arenas with the Attack Shark X1 White Tri-Mode Wireless Gaming Mouse, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by a full 1-Year official local agent warranty layout. Engineered with an ultra-lightweight 53g ergonomic mid-size profile structure, this flagship mouse is driven by the PixArt PAW3395PRO optical sensor delivering up to 40,000 DPI, 700 IPS speed, and 60G acceleration. Outfitted with Omron mechanical microswitches rated for 100 million clicks, high-accuracy TTC scroll encoder, an upgraded touchpad magnetic RGB charging dock station, and included anti-slip grip tape, it provides seamless tri-mode connectivity via low-latency 2.4GHz wireless, Bluetooth, or wired Type-C.
